assets.name: background
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE standalone portrait background asset for the Focus Quest settings UI. Reference attached screenshot for scenery and rendering style only. Remove all UI, text, frames, icons, phone status bar and navigation. Paint sunlit medieval white stone terrace arches at left covered with green ivy and white blossoms, royal blue hanging banner with gold compass at left, distant pale castle at right, snowy blue mountains and vivid blue sky with white clouds, waterfall at lower right. Keep center mostly soft distant sky and landscape for UI readability. Rich hand painted fantasy game illustration, match reference colors and composition. Portrait 9:16. No text or UI.

assets.name: section_header
assets.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. ONE standalone reusable empty section header banner for Focus Quest settings. Match screenshot royal blue textured enamel, ornate polished gold double borders, filigree curled gold corners, small diamond flourish at middle bottom. Wide horizontal rectangle ratio 11:1 with beveled clipped corners, all edges fully visible, front orthographic. Blue interior empty for code-rendered section labels, no text, no symbols or icons. Transparent outside banner. Reference screenshot style only.

assets.name: parchment_panel
assets.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. ONE standalone empty parchment panel asset for Focus Quest settings. Match attached reference settings pale ivory cream parchment, fine antique paper texture, elegant thin embossed gold double border, ornate small curled filigree at four corners, softly rounded rectangular silhouette. Front orthographic, width to height ratio 3:2. Entire interior blank, very light cream for dark text readability. No text, no header, no icons. All edges fully visible. Transparent outside panel, no backdrop. Restrained corners compatible with stretching central area.

assets.name: title_banner
assets.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. ONE standalone settings title ornament for Focus Quest game. Match attached screenshot TOP TITLE plaque exactly in style. Blank center for separately rendered title and subtitle. No lettering, no text. All ornament fully visible with padding. Transparent outside silhouette. Luxury hand painted fantasy RPG UI, crisp detailed gold work.
